# SafePDFHub

> Browser-based PDF tools and DOCX conversion.

This is a public navigation index. Each linked tool page is authoritative for its current workflow, supported formats, device limits, and limitations. User documents and processing results are not public content.

## PDF tools
- [Compress PDF](https://safepdfhub.com/tools/compress-pdf): Compress PDFs in your browser. Choose quality or a target size, review the actual result, and download. Your documents stay on your device.
- [Merge PDF](https://safepdfhub.com/tools/merge-pdf): Merge two or more PDFs in your chosen order without uploading them. Review the result and download one combined PDF from your browser.
- [Split PDF](https://safepdfhub.com/tools/split-pdf): Split a PDF or extract selected pages and page ranges locally in your browser. Create new PDF files while keeping your original unchanged.
- [Protect PDF](https://safepdfhub.com/tools/protect-pdf): Add password protection to a PDF in your browser. Choose your password, review optional permissions, and download a protected copy.
- [Unlock PDF](https://safepdfhub.com/tools/unlock-pdf): Remove PDF password protection when you know the password. Unlock locally in your browser and download a separate copy without uploading your document.
- [Sign PDF](https://safepdfhub.com/tools/sign-pdf): Place a visible signature, initials, text, dates, or checkboxes on PDF pages. Review and download the result locally, with no signup.
- [Watermark PDF](https://safepdfhub.com/tools/watermark-pdf): Add a text or image watermark to selected PDF pages. Adjust position, opacity, and rotation, then download the result from your browser.
- [PDF to Word](https://safepdfhub.com/tools/pdf-to-word): Convert PDF to Word locally. Choose editable text with English, Hindi or Marathi OCR, or preserve pages as images. Review and download your DOCX.
- [Word to PDF](https://safepdfhub.com/tools/word-to-pdf): Convert a DOCX to a downloadable PDF in your browser without uploading the document. Review formatting and conversion notes before sharing.

## PDF help guides
- [Browse PDF guides](https://safepdfhub.com/guides)
- [How to compress a PDF to a specific size](https://safepdfhub.com/guides/compress-pdf-to-target-size): Set a PDF target size in MB, check the actual result, and decide what to do when a document cannot fit a 1 MB, 2 MB or 5 MB limit.
- [How to compress a scanned PDF and keep it readable](https://safepdfhub.com/guides/compress-scanned-pdf): Understand image-heavy PDFs, choose a compression mode, and check text, stamps, and diagrams before sharing a smaller scanned document.
- [Why your PDF is not getting much smaller](https://safepdfhub.com/guides/why-pdf-size-is-not-reducing): Learn why optimized PDFs may shrink very little, how compression modes differ, and which checks to make before trying again.
- [How to merge PDF files in the right order](https://safepdfhub.com/guides/merge-pdf-files-in-order): Prepare PDF files, arrange their order, merge locally, and check page boundaries, orientation, and file size in the finished document.
- [How to extract selected pages from a PDF](https://safepdfhub.com/guides/extract-pages-from-pdf): Select PDF pages using workspace positions, avoid printed-page-number confusion, and verify the extracted files before sharing.
- [How to convert a scanned PDF to Word with OCR](https://safepdfhub.com/guides/convert-scanned-pdf-to-word): Choose editable text or page appearance, select English, Hindi or Marathi OCR, and proofread uncertain words and numbers in the DOCX.
- [Why Word-to-PDF conversion can change your layout](https://safepdfhub.com/guides/word-to-pdf-formatting): Troubleshoot font substitution, wrapping, spacing, tables, and extra pages when converting a DOCX to PDF in the browser.
- [How to choose a private PDF workflow](https://safepdfhub.com/guides/private-pdf-tools): Compare local browser and server processing, understand device limits, and check the privacy details of a PDF workflow before selecting a file.
